# Envirocycle Glasgow

> Licensed waste management, rubbish removal, uplifts and recycling company covering Glasgow and the surrounding Central Scotland area. Family-run, SEPA-registered waste carrier (WCR/R/3021188). Same-day collections available for homes, businesses, and trades.

Envirocycle Glasgow collects, sorts, and disposes of household, commercial, and trade waste. Reusable items are donated to local charities where possible; the rest is recycled or disposed of at licensed facilities. Every job comes with a waste transfer note for full compliance and audit trail.

Founded in 2025 by Chris Heenan and Liam McCormick. Four-person team, £1-2 million public liability insurance, 400+ jobs completed. Full story: https://envirocycleglasgow.com/about

## Booking and pricing
Quotes are free and based on the waste categories and volume involved; the quoted price is the lowest matching rate across the categories selected, not a sum of each. Get a quote at https://envirocycleglasgow.com/book or by phone/WhatsApp. No fixed operating hours — collections run by appointment, including same-day where possible.

## Licensing and compliance
Registered waste carrier with the Scottish Environment Protection Agency (SEPA), licence WCR/R/3021188. A waste transfer note is issued on every commercial and trade job.
